gzip:
[-c] [-kqn] [-1..9] [FILE]...
Compress stdin to stdout, or -c FILEs to stdout. Inputs are never removed.
Levels 1-3 use level 4, as upstream; default 6. -n omits name/time (default).
No in-place compression, -f/-v, or recursive mode. Use gunzip for decompression.

[-c] [-t] [FILE]...
Decompress stdin to stdout, or -c FILEs to stdout. -t verifies without output.
Checks CRC and uncompressed size; supports concatenated gzip members.
Inputs are never removed; no automatic filename replacement.

tar:
-t[v]f ARCHIVE [MEMBER...] | -xOf ARCHIVE [MEMBER...]
List or extract data to stdout from uncompressed POSIX tar. -f - reads stdin.
Names match exactly, not glob patterns. -v lists member names.
No creation, filesystem extraction, -C, compression, GNU/PAX extended names,
links or Unix metadata restoration. Use gunzip separately for .tar.gz input.
